ledger.title: listSafe makes saved pre-14.2 seeds with commas read as drift
Separator rewrite also changes display-block text that is never split
ledger.disposition: Withdrawn by the reviewer: The rejection holds on the evidence. In non-test src, resolvePrefillSource is called only from stageDriftKeys (src/stages.ts:393); the renderer's display blocks read the consumer-supplied resolved map, so no code in this package shows the rewritten text in a display block. stages.ts is declared a mirror of prefill.py, and the parity fixture in src/stages.test.ts pins resolver-level output, so moving the rule to list seeding only would break the stated parity. Whether display blocks should keep commas is a decision for the server side, outside this change.
